notes: Two separate numeral phrases, each writing its own `שָׁנָה`; neither occurrence is resumptive, so rule 22's tail-to-tail count does not arise and each `שָׁנָה` takes the *years* written for it.

Rule 42's count is satisfied by pairs: the clause-opening waw s008 takes the *and* before *he reigned*, the units-to-tens waw s010 takes the *and* between *nine* and *twenty*, and s005 takes the *and* between *five* and *twenty*.

`בֶּן` carries the whole recast age frame *when he was ... old*, discontinuous around the numeral under rule 25 and headed on *old* as the word the recasting turns on; no other morpheme in the clause is free to hold it.
